description: Aspen Plant Scheduler is AspenTech's software for building and managing production schedules for continuous, semi-continuous and batch operations. Users model a facility's own constraints in configurable software, start from industry-specific templates, see schedule disruptions and key performance indicators in real time, and drag and drop scheduling activities to see the effect on carbon dioxide emissions. It is made by AspenTech, which sells it within its supply chain management suite alongside products such as Aspen Supply Chain Planner and Aspen Collaborative Demand Manager. Coverage is global, with applications listed for bulk and specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, downstream refining, midstream and LNG. It is proprietary commercial software; the product page gives no price or licence terms and offers training and a contact form. Caveats: the page is marketing material with no technical detail on solvers, interfaces or deployment, and the tool serves plant owners, not outside researchers. For simulation it provides the scheduling layer for testing how plant outages, feedstock shortages or demand shifts change production plans, so it supports optimisation and capacity planning studies of chemical supply chains. It is related to the Aspen Plus process simulation record in this catalogue, AspenTech's steady-state process model.
